'''Selth''' was part of a group of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] hired by [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Grigor (governor)|Grigor]] on [[M'haeli/Legends|M'haeli]] to capture the rebel [[Mora]]. When the group's leader, [[Glott]], incapacitated her and was subsequently attacked by [[Ranulf Trommer/Legends|Ranulf Trommer]], he handed his captive off to Selth, who delivered her to Grigor.
